title: Divergence: l1::emit_string_runtime_l1 bytes_eq twin diverges from 07-strings REQ-20 on the empty window at an OOB offset (certified ens panics at runtime)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_bytes_eq_l1_empty_window.rs::bytes_eq_l1_twin_empty_window_matches_certified_spec_value demonstrates the divergence (#[ignore]d, run with --ignored). AUTHORITY: .design/basis/07-strings.md REQ-20 — the twin computes 'the SAME value as the spec body'; the OOB-index exception cannot apply at n=0 (no index is accessed). SPEC (REQ-18 n<=0 arm): bytes_eq(_,_,5,5,0) = true; verus certifies the ens L3 (live: forge check exits 0, item L3). SHIPPED TWIN (l1.rs emit_string_runtime_l1): the window-first guard 'if ai_u + n_u > a.data.len() { return false }' returns false at (n=0, ai=5 > len=2). LIVE REPRO: forge check empty_window.th -> L3; forge build --entry run -> binary panics 'thermite L1 contract violation [ens]: bytes_eq(result, result, 5, 5, 0)'. A verus-PROVEN postcondition fails its own always-active runtime check — check/build VALUE divergence (distinct from #280's honest compile failure). Fix direction (generator's call): mirror the spec's n<=0 -> true arm before the window guard.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
Generator plan (#281, single-file minimal fix):

ROOT CAUSE — thermite-lower/src/l1.rs::emit_string_runtime_l1, the bytes_eq twin (l1.rs ~2410): the emitted twin runs the window-bounds guard "if ai_u + n_u > a.data.len() || bi_u + n_u > b.data.len() { return false; }" BEFORE handling the empty window. At (n=0, ai=5 > len=2) this returns false, but the spec body (REQ-18: if n <= 0 { true } else ...) is unconditionally true at n=0 — no index is accessed, so REQ-20 OOB-index exception cannot apply. A verus-PROVEN ens panics its own L1 check in the built binary.

FIX (mirror the spec n<=0 arm before the window guard): emit "if n == 0 { return true; }" as the FIRST statement of the twin (n is u64, so n==0 covers the spec n<=0 total-fn arm — comment states this). The window guard then only fires when at least one index is genuinely accessed, matching REQ-20 SAME-value clause.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
FIXED — commit 5d0bc8cb (thermite-lower/src/l1.rs, +13/-2 net production; tests -1; doc +1/-1).

ROOT CAUSE: the bytes_eq L1 exec twin ran the window-bounds guard BEFORE the empty-window case. At n=0, ai=5 > len=2 the guard returned false, but the spec body REQ-18 n<=0 arm is true unconditionally — no index is accessed.

FIX REQ-20 SAME-value: emit the n<=0 arm first, before the guard. n is u64 so n==0 equals the spec arm.
  BEFORE first stmt: let ai_u: usize = ai as usize;  ...then  if ai_u + n_u > a.data.len() || bi_u + n_u > b.data.len() { return false; }
  AFTER  first stmt: if n == 0 { return true; }       ...then the unchanged window guard
The window guard now fires only when n > 0 an index is genuinely accessed; the certified ens bytes_eq(result, result, 5, 5, 0) now runs CLEAN in the built binary.

No new pub API R-DEFER-1 n/a, twin body only. No contract weakened R-DEFER-9: the twin now matches MORE of the spec, not less. No golden carries the twin text the pin lowers it at runtime; none updated. The two-commit ceremony collapsed to one: the only doc change is the authorized illustrative-sketch rider offset 8 to 7, which the plan places in commit 1; no separate golden/pin bumps were produced.
